improvements.areaName: SEO Meta Description and OG Tags
improvements.suggestion:
<meta name="description" content="Gideon is your Claude-powered AI assistant for trade and business. Get instant answers, voice chat, and professional support. Try 3 free searches, then join from US$2/day.">
<meta property="og:title" content="GDN AI – Gideon | Your AI Trade & Business Assistant">
<meta property="og:description" content="Instant AI answers, voice chat, and unlimited workspace for business owners and traders. Powered by Claude. Try free, then join from US$2/day.">
<meta property="og:type" content="website">
<meta property="og:image" content="https://gdn.ai/og-image.jpg">
<meta property="og:url" content="https://gdn.ai/">
<meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image">
improvements.rationale: A clear meta description improves click-through rates from search results by communicating the core value prop (Claude-powered AI for trade/business), the free trial offer, and accessible pricing. Open Graph tags ensure professional previews when shared on LinkedIn, Twitter, and Facebook—critical for B2B audiences. These tags are foundational SEO and currently missing or generic on most new sites.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Meet Gideon — Your AI Trade & Business Assistant"

Subheading: "Get instant answers, voice chat support, and a professional workspace built for business owners and traders. Try three searches free — no credit card required."
improvements.rationale: The headline immediately introduces Gideon by name and clearly states what it does, building brand recognition. The subheading highlights three key value props (instant answers, voice chat, workspace) while addressing the target audience directly. Ending with the free trial offer and removing friction (no credit card) creates a low-commitment entry point that drives conversions.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches with Gideon, you'll be invited to become a member to continue. Membership starts at just US$2 per day, giving you unlimited access to Gideon's AI-powered trade and business support, voice chat, and your own dedicated workspace. Choose annual billing to save 30 percent.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the conversion moment when free users hit the paywall. It reframes the limitation as an invitation, reinforces value (unlimited access, voice chat, workspace), and highlights the annual savings—reducing friction and objections right when purchase intent is highest.
